title: Settings dialog must portal into #portal-container and not use inert/native dialog
answers: Why doesn't the settings dialog use quill Dialog?
Radix Themes styles missing inside settings dialog
Why is background not inert when settings is open?
body:
Settings overlays render through `SettingsDialogFrame` (features/settings/components/SettingsDialogFrame.tsx), which `createPortal`s into `#portal-container` (fallback `document.body`).
- Settings pages still use Radix Themes; its styles only apply inside the `<Theme>` root that `#portal-container` sits in. A quill `Dialog` portals to `body`, outside `<Theme>`, and drops the styles.
- Do not mark the app background `inert` or switch to a top-layer `<dialog>`: settings dropdowns/selects portal to `body`, outside the dialog, and would be disabled or covered.
- Focus is handled instead by `useDialogFocus` (focus in on open, Tab wrap, restore opener on close); the backdrop div blocks pointer input.
- Both `SettingsLayout` (route) and `SettingsDialog` (consent/pre-router) must use this frame.
applies: products/desktop/packages/ui settings overlay (route SettingsLayout and SettingsDialog)
